content: Catalog of mitochondria across life’s family tree unearths new roles for the cell’s powerhouse Survey of mitochondrial proteomes across eukaryotic taxa reveals clues to the organelle’s origins and functions, and suggests possible new opportunities for treating parasitic infections. By Leah Eisenstadt October 1, 2026 Credit: Agnieszka Grosso, Broad Communications The MitoCarta Tree of Life effort explores the functions and evolution of mitochondria.
